question.question:
A firm's fiscal year runs 1 January through 31 December (January is month 1). On the first day of month 3 it pays 3960 USD cash for insurance covering exactly 6 months from that day. Insurance expense is spread evenly over each month of coverage; coverage still unused at 31 December is reported as a prepaid asset. On the first day of month 8 it borrows 580000 USD at 10.75 percent a year. Each month, interest of one-twelfth of the annual rate accrues on the whole principal; it is settled in cash in arrears at the close of every 3-month period measured from the drawdown date, and a payment falling on 31 December is made that day. Interest accrued but unpaid at 31 December is an accrued liability. Determine the fiscal year's total recognized expense for insurance together with loan interest, irrespective of cash actually paid.

Answer format: use exact arithmetic through all intermediate steps, round only the final value half up to 2 decimal digits, and return only the numeric value interpreted in `usd` with no unit label or additional text.
